blind.description: A small circular ritual bowl or basin crafted from dark bronze or wood, supported by four short stubby feet. The interior of the bowl is filled near the brim with an opaque, flat pool of crimson red liquid (blood). The geometry is clean, solid, and stylized with smooth, intact surfaces.
blind.from_above: A circular brown ring framing an inner solid red disc, with small feet protruding slightly at the corners and casting a soft shadow to the upper-left.
blind.height_vs_figure: Roughly 8 to 10 inches tall (about one-eighth the height of the figure) and about 1.5 feet in diameter (similar width to the figure cylinder).
